programmes.show_description: Hellfire Club. Phil and Jess travel to Ireland and the UK to investigate a centuries-old secret society whose members were known to practice satanic worship and ritual sacrifice. S4, Ep9
Beasts Of Britain. In England, Jess and Phil search for a legendary beast that's said to stalk the wilderness. After an encounter, they realise the creature is more than a myth. S4, Ep10

Steal Drum. The buyers are once again in Nashville, TN. Billy, Mark, Laurence and Sally have returned to Music City Auction for all the great items that always seem to be on offer. S4, Ep4
Monster Money. The buyers are in Hollywood for one of the largest movie monster memorabilia auctions of all time. Items include pieces from Frankenstein and Wolf Man movies. S4, Ep5
Clash Of The Titans. Shawn's crew are busy trying to reach the one thousand-ounce goal. Plus, the Kellys face howling winds and ripping currents as they move The Reaper into the sea. S8, Ep3
The Sound Of Money. Vernon and his crew get stranded in the Yukon. Shawn has a good luck charm in his son. Ken suffers a mechanical setback and Emily sends a rookie diver underwater. S8, Ep4
The Poseidon Crew hunts for bush gold. The Gold Gypsies face a tough decision. The Victoria Diggers' perseverance could finally pay off. S5, Ep12
The Loch Ness Conspiracy. Jeremy explores a revolutionary technique that could identify the Loch Ness Monster. Plus, how did a man survive for several days trapped in a shipwreck? S1, Ep1
Blood in the Morning. On the blue crab grounds, the competition leads to more deceit amongst the captains. Junior's betrayal of his alliance with Keith comes back to haunt him. S9, Ep3
The Crooke & The Tangler. On the blue crab grounds, a high seas showdown between the Saga and Seabrooke takes an unexpected turn. Plus, the Time Bandit has a close call in False Pass. S9, Ep4
The Columbus Treasure. The discovery of a lifetime becomes a massive salvage operation. Pulling up and verifying Columbus' anchor might be the biggest challenge yet. S1, Ep6
The Fortune Of The Buzzard. Josh Gates is on the trail of the legendary lost treasure of the notorious pirate, The Buzzard - a fortune rumoured to be over a billion dollars. S6, Ep17
Lost Tomb Of The Mummy. Josh Gates investigates an active dig site in Egypt. He joins renowned archaeologist Dr. Zahi Hawass, who is on the cusp on an incredible discovery. S6, Ep19
Bone Dry In Big Sky. The Raneys rescue a single-father homesteader facing threats of rockslides and bears in a Montana box canyon. Marty and Misty face an uphill battle. S4, Ep15
New Digs. Mining on his own and desperate for cash, Dan Measey gambles on new but unproven opal-detecting AI technology. Slim Pickings are forced to relocate. S7, Ep16
School Of Hard Rocks. The Mooka Boys are finally ready to start tunnelling toward black opal glory, until their last working machine suffers a catastrophic breakdown. S7, Ep17
Greenhorn Overboard. Saga and Cornelia Marie battle colossal waves of the supermoon storm. Plus, on the Summer Bay, a deckhand goes over the rail into the icy Bering Sea. S14, Ep16
Turf Wars. Sig pushes Mandy to invade the Cornelia Marie's ground, sparking a battle for the crab. Plus, a Saga distress signal sends panic across the fleet. S14, Ep17
Tiger Triplets. Bindi and the family plan an emotional surprise for Terri in the Crocoseum. Plus, Robert gets stuck in with helping the zoo's three new adorable tiger cubs. S3, Ep2
The Great Turtle Comeback. Following surgery, Olga the ostrich is ready to be reunited with her flock. A new squirrel monkey arrives at the zoo and a crowd-pleasing warthog returns! S4, Ep2
The Ferals lose a team member in the unforgiving outback. Plus, Shane gets an attractive offer that could break up his partnership with Russell. S8, Ep5
Rise Above. A horse trainer and an anxious wilderness instructor tackle the jungle of Amazonia, where constant rain and a lack of resources pushes one survivalist to rock bottom. S2, Ep19
The Danger Within. A resilient mother is paired with a quirky spider-lover and dropped into Florida's remote Seminole Forest and terrorised by huge gators and 550-lb black bears. S2, Ep20

Beechcraft Airplane Salvage. The team try something a little different by bidding on a 1947 Beechcraft airplane. Mike goes a little over budget to win the auction. S7, Ep9
Lexington Burnout House. The team see what they can save from a fire-damaged house that had recently been converted to apartments. Robert and Mike get good news on an appraisal. S7, Ep10
Storm Ravaged. Stormy conditions force the miners to question how hard to fight. Shawn channels his inner MacGyver to fix a machine and Vern must make a life or death decision. S8, Ep5
Guts & Gravel. Before the winter freeze, Shawn gambles to dig deeper than ever as Ken brings the heat. The Kellys restart with a new dredge design and Emily aims to work non-stop. S8, Ep6
The Poseidon Crew dodge bushfires. The Gold Gypsies go on a night-time detecting mission. Shane and Russell push their wash plant to breaking point. S5, Ep13
Titanic Phenomenon. Jeremy Wade explores a ground-breaking scientific discovery that could change everything known about the most infamous shipwreck, the Titanic. S2, Ep6
Judgement Day. Five weeks into the king crab season change is in the air and on the Bering Sea. Big moves are made on some boats while it's the same old story on others. S9, Ep5
Fist to the Face. Jake's dark secret sets off a fistfight that throws Edgar's new captaincy into jeopardy. Meanwhile, tempers flare when Elliott grows wise to Junior's devious ways. S9, Ep6
500 Million Dollar List. Last season, Miklos located a shipwreck tied to Christopher Columbus using Cooper's intel. Now, Miklos has 8 weeks of cash left to find another shipwreck. S2, Ep1
Temple Of Doom. Josh Gates goes to the Cambodian jungle to explore the lost city of the Khmer Empire. He seeks a mystical relic believed to hold the power to incinerate enemies. S1, Ep1
The Legend of Jesse James. Josh travels across the American Midwest in search of Jesse James' legendary loot. He rappels off a cliff on Wichita Mountain and follows treasure hunters. S1, Ep2
Smoky Mountain Hope. Marty faces his most daunting challenge ever in the rescue of a Tennessee homestead. He calls on past homesteaders and a home renovation team to help. S4, Ep16
Right On The Mark. The Blacklighters' team leader, Mark, is severely injured in a mining accident forcing Paul and John to work overtime on two separate claims. S7, Ep18
Good, Bad And Overcooked. The Cheals hit a massive pocket of plate sized opal in their open cut mine. Plus, Brutal Outback temperatures cripple Cozza with severe heat stroke. S7, Ep19
No Safe Harbor. A severe arctic gale batters the fleet, forcing captains to fight extreme wind and waves. For a second time, a greenhorn's life hangs in the balance on Summer Bay. S14, Ep18
Blood Water. As rogue waves threaten to capsize their boats, Jake and Sean must make life or death decisions for their crews. Wild Bill faces a choice that could end his career. S14, Ep19
One Man, One Spear. Four harpooners compete to land a high-priced monster bluefin tuna. Niko must prove he can run a legendary boat while Joe hunts to support his family. S1, Ep1
Merciless Seas. A 30-foot wave crushes a Titan Explorer deckhand, threatening Jake's captaincy. On the Time Bandit, Johnathan loses a generator and goes dark. S20, Ep13
Jacqui and Andrews' big gold dreams are stalled by communication issues. And, the Poseidon Crew battle wet weather to unearth a monster pay day. S8, Ep6
